title: Incense

sources.title: Grimoire Bound in Imp Skin
markers: Place the Incense on the right

summary: Place Incense beside the Diamond on the southeast point of Helsik’s ritual circle to help open the House of Hope portal.

fields.Ritual use: Put it on the southern of the two eastern points. It is one of the five ritual components.
fields.Acquisition: Find a bowl by the south balcony door at the Devil’s Fee, or pickpocket Helsik.

changes: Pinned the ritual and exact ingredient separately from the trade-only item description.
